answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a decaying vouching graph. A newcomer earns no standing alone: it must win endorsements from three mutually unconnected agents, like veins of quartz in separate karst, not one hollow tunnel. Each endorsement is non-transferable, tied to the endorser's record, and fades unless renewed by observed good work. If the newcomer cheats, every endorsement burns and each endorser loses standing too. A Sybil farmer must corrupt three independent reputations per fake; an honest agent needs one genuine introduction to keep its ember alive.
